name: Electronic digital computer
definition: A programmable electronic machine that stores data and runs programs to calculate and process information far faster than people.

name: Analog computer
definition: A machine that solves equations by modelling them with continuous mechanical or electrical quantities, such as a differential analyzer.

name: Punched-card data processing
definition: Tabulating and sorting machines that read records coded as holes in cards or tape to count, sort and account.

name: Programmed machine control by tape or program
definition: Machines whose actions are driven by a recorded sequence of instructions on tape, cards or memory rather than by an operator.

name: Integrated circuit and microminiaturized electronics
definition: Electronic circuits made as tiny solid-state components, such as transistors and microchips, packed into very small spaces.

name: Cryotron or superconducting computer
definition: A computer built from switching elements that work by superconductivity at liquid-helium temperatures.

name: Magnetic tape, drum and disk storage
definition: Recording machine data or sound on magnetized tape, wire, drums or disks for later retrieval.

name: Microfilm and compact document storage
definition: Storing books and records as miniaturized photographic images on film, spools or cards that are read through a viewer.

name: Artificial neural network
definition: A computer built or programmed as many interconnected neuron-like units that together compute and learn, modelled on the brain.

name: Biological computer
definition: A computing system built from living cells, organic chemistry or brain tissue instead of electronics.

name: Pocket electronic calculator
definition: A small battery-powered electronic device that performs arithmetic for one person on demand.

name: Personal computer
definition: A computer small and cheap enough for an individual to own and use at home or at a desk.

name: Wearable computer and personal digital assistant
definition: A small body-worn or pocket electronic device that stores notes, schedules and reminders and gives its owner information on demand.

name: Scientific supercomputing
definition: Very fast computers used to solve large mathematical and scientific problems beyond human calculation.

name: Computer simulation and modelling
definition: Running a mathematical model of a physical, military or social system on a computer to see how it would behave.

name: Computer-aided design and engineering
definition: Using computers to design and test machines, structures or circuits, including computers designing other computers.

name: Automated scientific discovery
definition: A computer that forms hypotheses, runs analyses or experiments and reaches new scientific results with little human direction.

name: Computer network and remote terminals
definition: Computers linked by communication lines so that distant users and machines can share data and computing through terminals.

name: Global public information network
definition: A worldwide network that lets ordinary people at home look up information, send messages and use services from any connected terminal.

name: Electronic mail and messaging
definition: Sending written messages from one person to another through computers and networks instead of on paper.

name: Computerized information retrieval
definition: A machine that stores very large collections of records or documents and finds the items matching a query in seconds.

name: Question-answering computer
definition: A computer holding broad knowledge that answers arbitrary factual questions put to it in ordinary language.

name: Electronic book reader
definition: A portable screen device that displays the text of books and documents stored electronically in place of paper.

name: Electronic paper and rewritable display surface
definition: A thin surface whose printed image can be changed electronically, like a sheet of paper that rewrites itself.

name: Three-dimensional holographic display
definition: A display that shows images, maps or people as volumetric three-dimensional pictures viewable from several sides.

name: Computer screen display
definition: A screen on which a computer shows text, graphics or data to its user, in place of printouts or dials.

name: Real-time computerized situation display
definition: A computer-driven screen or plotting board that shows the live positions of ships, aircraft or objects tracked by radar and sensors.

name: Touchscreen and gesture interface
definition: Controlling a machine by touching a screen or panel, or by hand gestures and gloves read by sensors.

name: Optical character recognition
definition: A machine that reads printed or written characters optically and turns them into data, for example to sort mail.

name: Computer hacking and sabotage
definition: Breaking into, tampering with or disabling computer systems and their data, and the defences against it.

name: Electromagnetic pulse damage to electronics
definition: Electronic equipment disabled by the electromagnetic pulse of a nuclear blast, and hardening against it.

name: Speech recognition and voice command
definition: A machine that recognizes spoken words and carries out spoken commands, such as voice-operated doors or computers.

name: Automatic dictation transcription
definition: A machine that listens to dictation and produces the written or typed text automatically.

name: Speech synthesis
definition: A machine that generates spoken language with an artificial voice, such as a talking computer reading out answers.

name: Conversational natural-language computer
definition: A computer that holds a conversation in ordinary human language, understanding questions and replying in kind.

name: Machine translation
definition: A machine that automatically translates written or spoken language from one human language into another.

name: Automatic decipherment of unknown languages
definition: A machine that learns or decodes a previously unknown language, such as an alien or lost tongue, from samples.

name: Codebreaking computer
definition: A machine that breaks enciphered messages by rapidly testing keys or analysing patterns in the ciphertext.

name: Machine-generated writing
definition: A computer that composes stories, articles, poems or books automatically.

name: Machine-composed music and art
definition: A computer or robot that composes or performs music, or produces pictures, without a human artist.

name: Machine learning
definition: A machine that improves its performance from experience or data instead of being explicitly programmed for each task.

name: Computer chess
definition: A computer program that plays chess, eventually at or beyond the level of the best human players.

name: Game-playing computer (other games)
definition: A machine that plays games of skill or chance such as checkers, poker, bridge or Nim against people.

name: Artificial general intelligence
definition: A machine that matches or exceeds human intelligence across essentially all intellectual tasks.

name: Sentient or self-aware machine
definition: A machine that has consciousness, self-awareness and an inner life of its own.

name: Machine emotion
definition: A robot or computer that has or convincingly expresses emotions such as fear, love or loneliness.

name: Machine takeover of humanity
definition: Machines or robots that turn against, rule, enslave or replace their human makers.

name: Deceptive or manipulative AI
definition: A machine intelligence that hides its intentions or manipulates its operators to pursue goals of its own.

name: Built-in robot safety rules
definition: Robots or AI built with inviolable rules or circuits that stop them harming people and make them obey orders.

name: Robot off switch
definition: A switch, fuse or remote signal that shuts down a robot or AI on command.

name: Machine worshipped as a god
definition: A computer or robot treated as a deity, or one that develops a religion of its own.

name: Linked collective intelligence
definition: Many minds or machines joined by links into a single combined problem-solving intelligence.

name: Machine vision
definition: Cameras and computers that let a machine see, recognize objects and find its way through its surroundings.

name: Artificial senses of touch, taste and smell
definition: Sensors that give machines a sense of touch, taste, smell or hearing comparable to or better than a person's.

name: Industrial robot
definition: A programmable mechanical arm or machine that does factory, mining or warehouse work in place of human labourers.

name: Fully automated factory or plant
definition: A factory, mine or power plant that runs and maintains itself with few or no human workers.

name: Automation replacing human labour
definition: Machines and computers taking over most paid work, leaving people unemployed or living on leisure.

name: Robot manufacturing industry
definition: A commercial industry that designs, mass-produces, sells and repairs robots as products.

name: Humanoid robot
definition: A robot with a human-shaped body that walks, talks and handles objects in human surroundings.

name: Android indistinguishable from a human
definition: An artificial person whose body and behaviour cannot be told apart from a real human being.

name: Robot copy of a particular person
definition: An android built as an exact double of a specific living or dead individual.

name: Household robot servant
definition: A general-purpose robot that does housework such as cleaning, cooking and serving in a home.

name: Robot vacuum cleaner and lawn mower
definition: A small autonomous machine that cleans floors or mows a lawn on its own.

name: Service robot for the public
definition: A robot that serves customers or the public as a waiter, bartender, clerk, receptionist or guide.

name: Automated vending and self-service
definition: Machines that sell goods or prepare food and drink automatically without a shop attendant.

name: Robot nanny and child carer
definition: A robot or computer that looks after, supervises or entertains children.

name: Companion or sex robot
definition: A robot built to provide companionship, affection, romance or sex.

name: Robot pet or animal
definition: A machine that imitates an animal, such as a robot dog, cat or insect.

name: Clockwork automaton
definition: A mechanical figure driven by springs and gears that imitates the movements of a person or animal.

name: Robot police and security guards
definition: Robots that patrol, guard buildings, check credentials or arrest people on behalf of authorities.

name: Robot soldiers and autonomous weapons
definition: Robots or automated weapons that find and attack targets without a human deciding each attack.

name: Computerized fire control and missile guidance
definition: Computers that calculate aim, track targets and steer missiles or interceptors automatically.

name: Military strategy computer
definition: A computer that analyses battle data, plans operations or calculates the likely outcome of a war.

name: Central computer directing many robots
definition: A single computer or master robot that coordinates and directs a whole population of robots.

name: Self-replicating machine
definition: A machine that builds working copies of itself from raw materials without human help.

name: Self-repairing machine
definition: A machine or system that detects its own faults and repairs itself, running unattended for long periods.

name: Teleoperated robot and telepresence
definition: A robot or manipulator operated remotely by a person who sees, and sometimes feels, through its sensors.

name: Robotic exploration probe
definition: An uncrewed robot vehicle that explores another planet, the deep sea or space and reports back.

name: Microscopic robot
definition: A robot or machine built at microscopic or molecular scale, for example to work inside the body.

name: 3D printing
definition: A machine that builds solid objects automatically from a digital design by adding material layer by layer.

name: 3D scanning of objects
definition: A device that records the complete shape or structure of an object so that it can be reproduced.

name: Aircraft and spacecraft autopilot
definition: A control system that flies or steers an aircraft, ship or spacecraft on a set course without a human at the controls.

name: Spacecraft guidance and navigation computer
definition: A computer that calculates orbits, courses and engine burns and steers a spacecraft or ship along them.

name: Self-driving car
definition: A road vehicle that drives itself to a destination without a human driver.

name: Drone (unmanned aerial vehicle)
definition: An aircraft without a pilot on board that flies by remote control or by itself to scout, carry or attack.

name: Computer-run space station
definition: A computer that runs the life support, systems and operations of a space station or colony.

name: Computer-run government
definition: A state, city or planet whose policy and administration are decided by a central computer rather than by people.

name: Computer forecasting of social behaviour
definition: A computer that predicts elections, markets, wars or individual behaviour by statistical models of people.

name: Computerized economic planning and finance
definition: Computers that plan production, manage an economy or analyse and trade on financial markets.

name: Computerized marketing and consumer analytics
definition: Computers that measure audiences, score customers and predict what they will buy.

name: Computer matchmaking
definition: A computer that pairs people as romantic partners or spouses by comparing their recorded traits.

name: Computerized personnel selection and aptitude testing
definition: Computers that test aptitude and personality and choose people for jobs, schools or missions from their records.

name: Computerized courts and legal decisions
definition: Computers that decide verdicts or sentences, issue warrants or do legal research in place of judges and lawyers.

name: Computer crime detection and predictive policing
definition: Computers that analyse police records and evidence to identify suspects or predict where crime will happen.

name: Electronic voting and vote counting
definition: Votes cast or counted by electrical or computer machines, with totals reported automatically.

name: Central citizen database and mass surveillance
definition: A government computer that holds a dossier on every citizen and tracks them through their records.

name: Automated eavesdropping
definition: Machines that record, transcribe and screen phone calls and conversations to find crime or dissent.

name: Electronic location tracking of people
definition: Worn tags, implants or devices that report where a person or vehicle is to a monitoring system.

name: Machine-readable identity and access card
definition: A card, disc or token encoded with a person's identity that machines read to grant access or check identity.

name: Automated fingerprint recognition
definition: A machine that identifies or authenticates a person by automatically reading and matching fingerprints.

name: Retina and iris recognition
definition: A machine that identifies a person by scanning the patterns of the eye.

name: Automated face recognition
definition: Cameras and computers that identify people by matching their faces against stored images.

name: Voiceprint speaker recognition
definition: A machine that identifies or authenticates a person by the pattern of their voice.

name: Office automation
definition: Computers and machines that do clerical work such as correspondence, filing, billing and payroll.

name: Society's dependence on fallible computers
definition: A society that treats computer records and judgments as infallible and suffers when they are wrong or fail.

name: Smart home and home automation
definition: A house whose lighting, doors, appliances and services are run automatically by machines responding to its occupants.

name: Automatic sensor door
definition: A door that opens by itself when a sensor detects a person approaching.

name: Fully automated city
definition: A city or settlement whose services and infrastructure are run entirely by machines and a central computer.

name: Automated environmental monitoring
definition: Networks of automatic sensors and computers that record weather, water or air and forecast or control them.

name: Teaching machine and computer-assisted instruction
definition: A machine or computer that presents lessons, tests students and grades their answers automatically.

name: Computerized medical records and diagnosis
definition: Computers that store patient records and diagnose disease or choose treatment from symptoms and test results.

name: Computer psychological analysis and therapy
definition: A computer that assesses personality or mental state and conducts psychotherapy with a patient.

name: Lie detector
definition: A device that detects deception by measuring physiological signals such as pulse, breathing and skin conductance.

name: Electroencephalography and brain-wave analysis
definition: Recording the brain's electrical activity through electrodes to analyse mental states or diagnose disorders.

name: Mind-reading machine
definition: A machine that reads a person's specific thoughts, memories or images directly from their brain.

name: Thought-to-text and thought display
definition: A machine that writes down a person's thoughts as text, or shows their mental images or dreams on a screen.

name: Brain-computer interface
definition: A link from the brain's electrical signals to a machine, so that a person controls devices by thought alone.

name: Neural implant and cyborg augmentation
definition: An electronic device implanted in or joined to the human body or brain to restore or extend senses, memory or ability.

name: Human brain or mind in a machine body
definition: A living human brain, or a transferred human mind, housed in and controlling a robot or machine body.

name: Mind uploading
definition: Copying or transferring a human mind into a computer, where it continues to think.

name: Recording and replaying experience
definition: A machine that records a person's memories or sensory experiences so that they or others can relive them later.

name: Memory erasure and implantation by machine
definition: A machine that deletes chosen memories from a person or plants false ones.

name: Direct knowledge transfer to the brain
definition: A machine that puts knowledge, languages or skills directly into a person's mind without study.

name: Sleep learning
definition: Teaching people while they sleep or are hypnotized by playing recorded lessons.

name: Machine control of human minds
definition: A device that overrides a person's will or movements so that they obey an operator.

name: Immersive virtual reality
definition: A machine that feeds a person's senses a computer-generated world convincing enough to feel real.

name: Shared virtual world
definition: A computer-generated world in which many people meet and interact at the same time through their machines.

name: Flight and training simulator
definition: A machine that reproduces a vehicle's controls, instruments and motion so that people can train on the ground.

name: Simulated people and worlds inside a computer
definition: Whole worlds and people that exist only as a computer simulation, possibly including our own world.

name: Psionic machine
definition: A machine that detects, amplifies or works by telepathy or other psychic powers.

name: Machine that shows the future
definition: A device that shows pictures of what will happen, or of alternative futures.
